content.value_statement: Mobile apps often struggle to choose keywords, metadata, and launch plans that improve organic discovery. This skill provides ASO analysis, metadata guidance, review insights, and launch planning for Apple App Store and Google Play.
actual_capabilities: Analyze keyword candidates for estimated volume, difficulty, relevance, and long-tail opportunities.
Generate platform-specific titles, subtitles, descriptions, and Apple keyword fields with character checks.
Compare competitor metadata, visual assets, ratings, and positioning from user-provided app data.
Score ASO health across metadata, reviews, keyword performance, and conversion metrics.
Plan A/B tests, localization priorities, review responses, launch checklists, and update schedules.
limitations: Keyword volume and competition estimates are heuristic and not official Apple or Google data.
The skill needs user-provided app details, competitors, metrics, and reviews for accurate analysis.
Store rules and best practices change, so teams should verify current requirements before publishing.
It does not cover paid ads, technical app submission, or in-app analytics implementation.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New App Launch
use_cases.description: Create keyword priorities, metadata drafts, compliance checks, and launch timing guidance before store submission.

use_cases.title: Improve Organic Acquisition
use_cases.description: Review competitor positioning, evaluate ASO health, and plan tests for titles, screenshots, and descriptions.

use_cases.title: Turn Reviews Into Roadmaps
use_cases.description: Analyze public reviews to identify recurring issues, feature requests, sentiment changes, and response themes.

prompt_templates.title: Research Starter Keywords
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner keyword discovery for a new listing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to research ASO keywords for my app. The app category is [category], the audience is [audience], and the main features are [features].

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Store Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize my Apple App Store and Google Play metadata. Use my current title, subtitle, descriptions, target keywords, and brand constraints to propose better options.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Competitor Positioning
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my app listing against these competitors: [competitors]. Identify keyword gaps, metadata patterns, visual asset opportunities, and priority actions.

prompt_templates.title: Build an ASO Experiment Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ASO improvement plan using my rankings, conversion rate, review themes, target markets, and upcoming release date. Include test hypotheses and launch risks.

output_examples.input: A fitness app needs launch keywords and metadata direction for Apple App Store and Google Play.
output: A ranked keyword shortlist with relevance, competition, and long-tail notes.
Platform-specific title and description recommendations with character-limit guidance.
A launch checklist covering metadata, assets, compliance, testing, and post-launch monitoring.

output_examples.input: A productivity app has declining ratings and wants to understand recent public reviews.
output: A sentiment summary with positive, neutral, and negative review themes.
Common issue categories and feature requests prioritized by frequency.
Draft review response templates for crashes, bugs, feature requests, and positive feedback.

output_examples.input: A mobile team wants to test a new icon and first screenshot before a major update.
output: A clear test hypothesis, primary metric, variants, and expected duration.
Sample size guidance based on baseline conversion and expected lift.
A reporting outline for deciding whether to ship, iterate, or stop the test.

best_practices: Provide current metadata, target audience, category, competitors, and store performance metrics when possible.
Validate recommendations against current Apple and Google requirements before submitting changes.
Use ASO recommendations as experiments and track ranking, conversion, review, and download changes after release.
anti_patterns: Do not target high-volume keywords that are unrelated to the app experience.
Do not copy competitor metadata without checking relevance, brand fit, and store policy compliance.
Do not treat heuristic scores or third-party estimates as exact store algorithm data.

faq.question: Does this skill fetch live App Store or Google Play data?
faq.answer: No. It works from user-provided data and optional external research links noted in the skill documentation.

faq.question: Can it write final store metadata?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft titles, subtitles, descriptions, keyword fields, and update notes for review by your team.

faq.question: Does it guarantee higher rankings?
faq.answer: No. Store algorithms are proprietary, and outcomes depend on relevance, competition, conversion, ratings, and market changes.

faq.question: Which platforms are covered?
faq.answer: The workflows cover Apple App Store and Google Play Store metadata, launch planning, and optimization practices.

faq.question: Can it analyze user reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can summarize sentiment, recurring issues, feature requests, trends, and response templates from provided reviews.

faq.question: Is this useful for paid advertising campaigns?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on organic store discovery, conversion, reviews, localization, and launch planning.
